I remember being so obsessed with Undertale as a kid and then being super excited watching people play the SURVEY_PROGRAM when it had dropped. Every aspect of the game became so special to me and helped me through the darkest period of my life. Now, as an adult with a job, I saved up for a laptop with the main purpose being to play Deltarune. I'm so happy I did because it feels much more special getting to experience the actual thing and getting to visit the places I've been holding onto all this time.

The game itself, ignoring emotional attachment as much as I can, is also just really amazing. The characters are really memorable and so full of life, it's so easy to love who they are and who they are becoming. The bits of dialogue that come from interacting with things and people add humor, backstory, and life to this world. The music, as always, is just downright amazing and pairs amazingly with the visuals to create the perfect tone appropriate for each scene and area. The plot of every chapter has always felt very intriguing to watch develop, and each ending has created more excitement for whatever is next. The overarching story that's being developed is also just really interesting. 

Now, only a couple of chapters remain, which means it's almost time to say goodbye to Deltarune. At least, for the most part. Although the chaotic wackiness and goofy theories in between chapters may not return, and although there may be no more new content to wait for, all of the time I spent loving Deltarune will always be meaningful. The adventure will always be waiting for me to remember and cherish it. Please, give this game a chance if you can. Getting to watch someone's dream come to life is a really special feeling.

cohorts.label: 20-100h
cohorts.summary: Players highlight the quality soundtrack featuring diverse instruments alongside optional challenging secret boss fights.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game features optional, highly challenging secret boss fights.

citations.review_text:
This game is AMAZING! From story to gameplay, it's all so fun and interesting. It has an amazing concept, amazing character (seriously, it's impossible to NOT get attached!), the MUSIC...It's such a comfort game. Bosses are challenging to the perfect degree! Not frustratingly hard, not boringly easy. Well...the secret bosses on the other hand...yeesh..

But the story isn't like anything I've ever seen before! It's the type of story that anybody could be interested in. The game itself has the perfect balance between Sweet, Funny, Creepy, and downright Disturbing and I LOVE that.

Deltarune is one of my favorite games! It's got an interesting story, lovable characters, lots of funny jokes, and EXTREMELY cool fights! Plus, the most challenging fights are completely optional, which means I can just skip the ones that are too hard for me.

claims.claim: Reviewers highlight the soundtrack, noting its quality and the use of diverse instruments.

citations.review_text:
This is one of the few games that i think everyone should experience for themselves. The story's written in a way that i can't explain myself you'd just have to find out for yourself. The characters are so well written and unique in their own ways, The fighting mechanics are also great but the story is just a one of a kind. The second best thing about this game are the soundtracks. Music nowadays is really just the same stuff getting reused over and over again. But Toby Fox is a musical genius. He  utilizes instruments that everyone else overlooks, that shouldn't work but it does. I  like everyone out of the main cast but Ralsei's just my favourite. I love how he grows as a person. 
This is a 10/10 game for me i really recommend trying it out for yourself

This game has made me talk out loud to myself more than I can count.
It fills me with great joy, and determination to keep playing
(the songs haunt me everyday, I cannot hear a single song from the soundtrack without thinking of the game, great songs and story).

cohorts.label: 100h+
cohorts.summary: Long-term players note that the battle system improves upon predecessor titles with complex bullet patterns and unique boss mechanics.

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the battle system as an improvement over Undertale, featuring more complex bullet patterns and diverse, unique boss mechanics.

citations.review_text:
Good Game.

It is definitely for a specific audiance, I'd argue even more than Undertale, but if it scratches you're itch you'll fall in love with it. 

The battle system is improved from Undertales, with more complex bullet patterns and far more originality in terms of their attacks.

The story is absolutely the main focus, roping you in, forcing you to look deeper at every detail.

overall I'd give it an 8.5/10 overall, at least so far.

BONUS: game runs on almost everything


also, play Undertale first.

Genuinely my favorite game of all time, and it's only half complete. I wish I could put into words how much this game means to me but I seriously can't, doesn't mean I can't try though:

*As of now Deltarune has one of the most touching stories I've ever seen and it hasn't even ended yet, the themes of defying fate, refusing to be controlled or defined by others, and learning to find a balance of reality and escapism all hit very close to home, easily the best aspect of the game. Experiencing it firsthand is absolutely amazing, please don't just watch a playthrough, it's not worth spoiling it for yourself. I genuinely tear up sometimes imagining how this game will end, it's that close to me.
*The soundtrack is amazing and just gets better each chapter, Field of Hopes and Dreams is a bop, Don't Forget makes me cry, A Cyber's World is so hype, Black Knife is brutal, Dark Sanctuary and Neverending Night send me to a whole other plane of existence, I could go on, easily my second favorite game OST behind Minecraft.
*The gameplay is ridiculously fun and much like the OST gets better by the chapter. Yes at times its a bit of a walking simulator but all of the jokes and dialogue make sure it never gets stale. The boss fights themselves are all drastically unique from each other (especially the chapters' final bosses and secret bosses) with unique mechanics and ways of beating them. I'd say my favorite bosses but they'd be too big of spoilers, so I'll just say they're the secret bosses of chapters 3 and 4. Oh and of course the overworld gameplay in Chapter 5 is just perfect, don't wanna say much but I will say real-time combat goes perfect with this game.

Those are just my 3 favorite parts but I could go on and on about every little aspect of the game, like how lively the dialogue is, how amazing some of the visuals are (especially in chapters 4 and 5, just pure eye candy), and how fun it is to theorize about all the mysteries in this game.
